key_impacts: Reactor units were damaged, requiring long-term decommissioning.
Large volumes of contaminated water generated and stored on-site (about 1,100,000 m3 by Oct 2018).
Fuel debris deposits present in Units 1–3; retrieval required.
Spent fuel removal needed from Units 1–3 pools.
evidence_snippets: Following the accident at TEPCO’s Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Station (NPS) on 11 March 2011
addressing the situation of the damaged plants of Fukushima Daiichi and moving towards decommissioning
As of October 2018, about 1,100,000 m3 of treated water is stored on-site
missing_information: Casualty or displacement figures not provided.
Precise sequence/duration of releases not detailed.
